stories.title: 5 Questions That Could Reshape AI
stories.take: The 5 questions: 1) Anthropic's IPO — pricing Wed, trading Thu, ~$1.5T target, 6–7x oversubscribed • 2) An OpenAI spoiler model — GPT-6.2 Astra leaks, host bets on a release soon after the IPO • 3) Bring back Jensen — 175K-signature letter and an ally war room; Munster says 51% odds, Kalshi 9% • 4) Does Lutnick get sacrificed — he testifies Dec 10 on the Megaspeed entity-list delay • 5) Export controls — three bills in the NDAA, including closing the remote-access loophole

stories.title: Anthropic To Become the World’s Most Important AI Stock

stories.title: The e-readers readers love
stories.take: The no-questions-asked pick is still the Kindle Paperwhite — but new Kindles are heavier, aluminum and roughly double the old prices • Sleeper hit: XTE Ink's tiny X4 Pro (~$90) with touchscreen and warm light • Kobo is the more open hardware, but Kindle Unlimited exclusivity locks readers in • Android readers (Boox Palma 3, BigMe B7) run every store — at the cost of days-long battery
